_comment: Items on the ground and picking them up (#424). range: metres from the eye an item can be picked up; loot_reach_extra: how much further a crate or body's loot screen stays open. facing: how squarely you must face an item (the cosine of the angle off the crosshair: 0.8 is about 37 degrees either way, so a small item need not be hit precisely). ground_scale: how much bigger than in the hand an item is drawn on the ground, and min_size: the least metres across its longest side, so small things don't vanish in grass. outline: the glow added over the item a press would pick up (colour and strength).
